gaps.sentence: The burglar admitted ___ through the kitchen window.
gaps.explanation: 'Admit' is followed by a gerund: admitted climbing.

gaps.sentence: The box was heavy enough ___ two people.
gaps.explanation: adjective + enough + to-infinitive: heavy enough to need.

gaps.sentence: I resent ___ treated as an amateur when I have twenty years’ experience.
gaps.explanation: 'Resent' takes a gerund; the passive is 'being treated'.

gaps.sentence: The teacher made us ___ the whole essay again.
gaps.explanation: 'Make someone do' — active 'make' takes the bare infinitive.
deny + -ing or having + past participle: denied doing/having done. Both accepted.
would rather takes the bare infinitive: I'd rather stay.

gaps.sentence: I really can't afford ___ on holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: afford takes the to-infinitive: can't afford to go.

gaps.sentence: I've always wanted ___ how to sail.
